title: GTA 6 Completely Re-Engineered Weather System With Hurricanes and Rainbows
description: GTA6 Hub coverage: Rockstar Games has completely re-engineered the weather system for GTA 6, adding hurricanes, rainbows, and vertiginous clouds for an unprecedented scale.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Weather System Completely Re-Engineered for Unprecedented Scale

If you thought Red Dead Redemption 2's heavy winds and even heavier rain looked impressive, you might be happy to learn that Rockstar Games went back and completely re-engineered the weather system for GTA 6.

According to media reports from Eurogamer, the upcoming open-world title features a fundamentally rebuilt atmospheric engine designed to "achieve a sense of scale we haven't felt before." 

## What to Expect from the New Weather Engine

The technological leap brings a vast array of new environmental phenomena to the game world:

* **Hurricanes**: Destructive and massive tropical storms that threaten the region with intense atmospheric pressure and severe conditions.
* **Rainbows**: Subtle post-storm visual spectacles that add a layer of natural beauty and realism to the open world.
* **Vertiginous Cumulonimbus Clouds**: Towering, highly detailed cloud formations that stretch into the horizon, adding incredible vertical scale to the skies.
* **Heavy Rain**: Building upon the impressive physics seen in Rockstar's previous titles, heavy rainfall is set to look and feel more immersive than ever.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar Games continues to push the boundaries of open-world immersion. Re-engineering an entire weather system from the ground up demonstrates a commitment to detail that sets a high bar for the entire industry. The addition of dynamic hurricanes and stunning atmospheric touches means exploring this new world will be breathtaking.

As we await further details, the promise of a living, breathing world shaped by these advanced environmental systems gives fans even more reason to be excited.
